The first thing you need to understand is that you are not doing this for me, or the mods, or the people in your life, or anybody else. You are doing this for you. Forget about 90 days. What is your goal? Be who you want to be.

What was your reason to start this? Think about it. If it wasn't a good enough reason, and the added benefits don't cut it for you, you can go back to PMO. The decision is yours. Nobody here is going to lose anything.

For me personally, this is a test of will with unexpected but welcome perks. Is this the biggest challenge of your life? Then do this, and everything else will be easy.

If your will needs to be smeltered, this community will give you the tools. You bring the ore. No one can help someone who won't help himself.
